'''Bug Meat''' is a [[Monster Loot]] item which is dropped from any type of [[Adventurer's Guild#Cave Insect|insect]], including [[Armored Bug]]s and [[Armored Bug (dangerous)|Dangerous Armored Bugs]] if the player has forged their weapon with a [[Forge#Combat enchantments|Bug Killer enchantment]].

[[Dorado]], [[Lingcod]], or [[Pike]] [[Fish Pond]]s may produce 20 Bug Meat when the population of the pond reaches 9.

[[Vincent]] sells Bug Meat in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|1|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]].

==Bundles==
Bug Meat is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Bug Meat is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt027|link=Tailoring{{!}}Pink Striped Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a dark pink dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the purple dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*Ten Bug Meat may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].
*[[Willy]] requests 100 Bug Meat in the [[Quests#Juicy Bugs Wanted|"Juicy Bugs Wanted!"]] Special Order. The rewards are {{Price|3000}} and the [[Quality Bobber]] recipe.
*Twenty Bug Meat may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Used as an ingredient to the [[Sturdy Ring]] recipe. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. Can be produced by [[Fish Pond]]s.}}
{{History|1.5|Needed in the [[Quests#Juicy Bugs Wanted|"Juicy Bugs Wanted!" Special Order]]. Used as an ingredient to the [[Bug Steak]] and [[Magic Bait]] recipes.}}
{{History|1.6|Can now be purchased at [[Desert Festival]]. May now be requested by the Raccoon.}}
